video_title: Miles Bridges Training Camp Media Availability | 10-1-26

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his connection to Detroit and his family
quotes.excerpt: I still have a lot of family out there and of course I'm from there so it's always special.
quotes.quote: My rookie year I started off having 80 tickets every time I came back to Detroit and as the years went by it went down and down but I still have a lot of family out there and of course I'm from there so it's always special.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges reflects on his roots in Detroit and how his ticket requests have changed since his rookie season as he prepares for the new year with the Suns.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on learning the Suns' offensive and defensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: I'm just learning, learning everything from offense, defense, the calls, and just getting to know my teammates.
quotes.quote: I'm just learning, learning everything from offense, defense, the calls, and just getting to know my teammates more and more. So really I'm just learning and I'm feeling good about that.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he is currently focused on learning the Suns offensive and defensive schemes as he integrates into the team during training camp.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' dynamic scoring options
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot of dynamic scorers, so like I said, just learning each other's games.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of dynamic scorers, so like I said, just learning each other's games. It's going to make it easier for me to playmake. I'm already a willing passer. If I get the rebound I want to push and get guys open and get them to their spots. Everybody is a willing passer on this team and I'm happy to play with them.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges believes the Suns roster is full of willing passers which will make his job as a playmaker easier this season.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on how his versatility helps the Suns' offense
quotes.excerpt: Teams can't strong me or weak me, which means send me to the right or left.
quotes.quote: Teams can't strong me or weak me, which means send me to the right or left, because I'll go either way. So I feel like that helps our offense in many ways. We got a lot of people on our team that, Devin, he likes going left, Dylan likes going left, Jaylen likes going right, but like I said, just figuring everything out and it's helping me.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says his ability to go either left or right helps the Suns offense because teams cannot force him in one direction.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' shift to a more physical defense
quotes.excerpt: Much more physical defense. We want it's all up in your face defense, want to turn you over.
quotes.quote: Much more physical defense. We want it's all up in your face defense, want to turn you over. I'm used to playing conservative, just trying to play the whole shot clock out, but with this team we actually want to turn teams over and that's something I got to get used to.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges notes a shift in defensive philosophy for the Suns as they move toward a more physical style designed to turn opponents over.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on improving his defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: I like to think people up 94 feet, probably not as good as Rudy, but I'm trying to get there.
quotes.quote: I like to think people up 94 feet, probably not as good as Rudy, but I'm trying to get there. But, you know, I'm getting used to the defense.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he is working on picking up players 94 feet away as he adjusts to the defensive intensity expected in Phoenix.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the balance between defensive pride and skill
quotes.excerpt: You got to want to play defense to be in this league, but it's hard to play both sides.
quotes.quote: I feel like it's a happy medium with both. You got to want to play defense to be in this league, but it's hard to play both sides of the floor. At the same time you got to know what you're doing out there. So that's where my learning piece is coming in at, and I already have the pride on defense.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on the challenge of playing both ends of the floor and finding the balance between defensive pride and tactical knowledge.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the importance of defensive communication
quotes.excerpt: Covering somebody up on the back end comes with a lot of communication.
quotes.quote: We already got a lot of guys that communicate well. Covering somebody up on the back end comes with a lot of communication. So you know, we got vets like Dylan and Devin talking nonstop also. Even, he talks a lot during practice, you would be surprised, but it's all about communication.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges highlights the importance of communication on the defensive end and credits veterans like Devin and Dylan for leading the way in practice.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' potential as playmakers
quotes.excerpt: One of us is going to have a mismatch, whether it's a smaller player or somebody that doesn't play defense.
quotes.quote: One of us is going to have a mismatch, whether it's a smaller player or somebody that doesn't play defense. So just getting open shots out of that will definitely help our percentages get higher. We're going to try to touch the paint more this year, and by doing that our shooters are going to be open.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says the Suns plan to prioritize touching the paint this season to create open shots and improve their shooting percentages.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his mentorship role with young players
quotes.excerpt: Our young guys are very coachable. Rasheed is a leader in himself.
quotes.quote: It's easy. Our young guys are very coachable. Rasheed is a leader in himself. So just teaching Koa, teaching Rasheed, because those guys are going to be awesome within the next few years, so I'm happy to be in that type of role with them.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges is embracing a mentorship role with the Suns young players like Rasheed and Koa and says the group is very coachable.
